actions_inputs_present.name: actions_inputs_present
actions_inputs_present.value: ("actions"."input_purged_at" is null) = ("actions"."proposed_input" is not null and "actions"."input" is not null)

actions_inputs_object.name: actions_inputs_object
actions_inputs_object.value: ("actions"."proposed_input" is null or jsonb_typeof("actions"."proposed_input") = 'object') and ("actions"."input" is null or jsonb_typeof("actions"."input") = 'object')

connect_attempts_outcome.name: connect_attempts_outcome
connect_attempts_outcome.value: ("connect_attempts"."consumed_at" is null) = ("connect_attempts"."connection_id" is null and "connect_attempts"."failure_code" is null)

documents_connection.name: documents_connection
documents_connection.value: ("documents"."origin" = 'connection') = ("documents"."connection_id" is not null and "documents"."external_id" is not null)

facts_current_unique.name: facts_current_unique
facts_current_unique.where: "facts"."status" = 'confirmed' and "facts"."valid_to" is null and "facts"."attribute" is not null

facts_superseded_ended.name: facts_superseded_ended
facts_superseded_ended.value: "facts"."superseded_by_id" is null or "facts"."valid_to" is not null

playbook_examples_has_source.name: playbook_examples_has_source
playbook_examples_has_source.value: "playbook_examples"."source_event_id" is not null or "playbook_examples"."source_action_id" is not null

playbooks_confirmed_at.name: playbooks_confirmed_at
playbooks_confirmed_at.value: "playbooks"."status" not in ('confirmed', 'retired') or "playbooks"."confirmed_at" is not null
